operations.description: Wildcards require dns-01 and a provider in the same tenant scope. A 202 response only persists a tenant-scoped pending intent and its audit event; it does not claim CA acceptance. Reusing an Idempotency-Key with a different scope, domain set, challenge, provider, or auto-renew value returns a conflict. HTTP-01 forbids dns_provider_id; DNS-01 requires a verified same-tenant provider. Entitlement authorization is a separate fail-closed server composition requirement and is not implied by RBAC.

fields.name: issuer
fields.description: The CA. Omitted uses the requesting user's default issuer, then the platform default. The resolved CA is frozen on the order and its renewals; a CA without platform EAB credentials is refused with 409 certificate_issuer_unavailable. An order for the same domain set that is still pending, validating or issuing refuses the new order with 409 certificate_order_in_flight.
